page.layout: One printed page of running text, set in one column, with a dedication closing and signature below. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the lower half and at the left edge; no marginal notes of its own.

p.i: iure dedico & ut pro solita vestra humanitate æqui boniqué consulatis, etiam atque etiam rogo. Quod reliquum est Deum Opt. Max. precor, ut A. V. consilijs & actionibus præsit & quam diutissimè ad reipublicæ & ecclesiæ incrementum incolumes & felices conseruet. Leydæ anno Christi clo. Io. ic. Octobris iii. quo die ante annos xxv. diuino aquarum beneficio & Illustriss. ac beati Principis Auriaci Gvilielmi Nassovii copijs ab arctissima Hispanorum obsidione liberata est.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page is present in the lower half and was not transcribed. The catchword is read from the final line as printed "ANTICO-". Some words in the first line are doubtful: "ut pro" and "boniqué" read as printed. Dates "clo. Io. ic." and "iii." are copied as they appear, the numerals partly unclear.
